title: Extensibility
slide_intent: Extend one visual language to different narrative jobs so audiences can connect new messages to a familiar source.
strategic_value: Food-centered metaphors can let Sweetgreen discuss business and culture without abandoning its core subject.
demonstration: Five labeled panels illustrate Food & Nature, Business, Ethos & Culture, Engagement and People through vegetables, small figures and objects.
practical_value: Use the panel labels to compare how a visual metaphor changes when the communication purpose changes.

content_islands.name: Upper stories
content_islands.spec: Place Food & Nature and Business in the wide upper panels.

content_islands.name: Lower stories
content_islands.spec: Place Ethos & Culture, Engagement and People in three lower panels; keep each label with its example.

reference_purposes.Intent: The Extensibility caption explains keeping diverse narratives anchored in food.
reference_purposes.Application: Five labeled examples apply the illustration system to distinct storytelling needs.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large colorful ingredients and small line figures recur across the five stories.
